description:
Pallavi Rajadhyax is a quintessential education counsellor. She graduated in Commerce and followed it up with a double MBA with specializations in Marketing and Finance, both from Pune University. 

Pallavi started as a Finance professional working with marquee names like Citibank and ICICI Prudential. However she found her calling in teaching and has spent 2 decades as an educator teaching in MBA Colleges as well as High Schools. She has also taught as a tutor to students of French across multiple boards and also instructed working professionals.

Pallavi has also worked as a Career Counsellor and guided many students to admissions and scholarships across multiple foreign universities both at an Undergraduate and Post-Graduate Level.

She has professional certifications in French including DELF (French Ministry of National Education) and has completed a Certificate Course in French in Belgium and Alliance Francaise, Pune.  Pallavi also has a Global Career Counselling Certification offered by the University of California, Los Angeles (UCLA extension) and a Green Belt global Career Certification offered 

Pallavi rounds off her formidable expertise as a counsellor with a deep knowledge of the culture of Western Countries through her stay in Europe and USA. This combined with her patience and ability in partnering with students and parents alike make her a very effective Counsellor.
